purpose: Post-restart compatibility check for paginated buyer-refund history recovery; no new inference or settlement

verification.scope: Stored evidence and independently read configured chain; controller trust remains
checks: hash-linked events bound to the Deal and mandate
versioned delivery structure and quality checks; no factual certification
preview raw content revalidated and bound to the immutable Deal
seller/company control mapped to a recomputed failed-delivery refund
policy arithmetic; preview flags checked against actual preview evidence
settlement attestation binds Deal, mandate, delivery, preview and final checks
independent canonical/finalized RPC receipts, exact amounts, participants, deadlines and outcome
unverified: Dataset factual truth and source relevance are not verified; source URLs are not fetched.
Controller remains trusted for off-chain authorization, timestamps and complete event capture.
Historical absence of controls and cross-Deal reservation completeness are not independently proven.
Transaction claims are public decoded summaries, not independently authenticated until RPC corroboration.
Demo native test asset scale is not USD; SQLite and blockchain are not distributed-atomic.

usage.ttft_note: Non-streaming API used; TTFT was not measured.

energy.label: Energy Estimate — Assumption Based
energy.method: If organizer supplies application-attributable average watts P, estimate E=P×sum(latency_ms)/1000. API latency includes queue/network; this is not hardware active time.
energy.source: No organizer power assumption or application power telemetry supplied; no numerical estimate is presented.
energy.limitations: No application-measured energy, utilization, batching attribution, or verified baseline. Token/call totals are measured; reduction relative to another design is not yet measured.

limitations: Historical workbench transactions only; long-history recovery is covered by the separate local EVM regression.
Not a new public-chain run or a controller-settlement-race test.
